summary.text: ARNEBRÅTVEIEN BARNEHAGE AS is a private limited company registered in Sarpsborg, founded 2004-03-15. Arnebråtveien Barnehage AS operates kindergartens. It was previously named BARNAS BARNEHAGE ARNEBRÅTVEIEN AS until 2020-11-28. Its main industry code is 85.100: pre-primary education. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 16 993 783 NOK and the annual result was 181 894 NOK; operating income was up from 16 773 781 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 250 013 NOK in 2024 to 181 894 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 684 183 NOK in 2024 to 834 840 NOK in 2025. It has 1 open position listed, most recently "Barnehagelærer". The registered employee count went from 26 on 2025-12-13 to 23 on 2026-09-15. The register's most recent update was on 2026-09-15 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
